presentation.description: A layered star-flame: a ✧ core inside a slow heart-yantra halo. It gathers when idle, spins into a vortex when working, and flickers between ✧ and ❋ when it speaks.

scene.character: Anima — the composer's flame at rest: gathered, breathing.
scene.name: Idle

scene.character: Anima — the composer's flame at work: a turning vortex, the body resonating.
scene.name: Working

scene.character: Anima — the composer's flame speaking: the inscription flickers between forms.
scene.name: Speaking

scene.character: Anima — the composer's flame: invoke skill while the current Scene continues.
scene.name: Invoke skill

scene.character: Anima — the composer's flame: operate while the current Scene continues.
scene.name: Operate
